passive.name: Protector's Virtue
passive.text: HP increased by **20/25/30/35/40%**. Additionally, provides an ATK Bonus based on **1.2/1.5/1.8/2.1/2.4%** of the wielder's Max HP.

passive.name: Northwind Wolf
passive.text: DMG dealt by Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst is increased by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When an Elemental Skill hits an opponent, its CRIT Rate will be increased by **2/2.5/3/3.5/4%**. When an Elemental Burst hits an opponent, its CRIT Rate will be increased by **2/2.5/3/3.5/4%**. Both of these effects last 10s separately, have 4 max stacks, and can be triggered once every 0.1s.

passive.name: Windfall
passive.text: CRIT Hits have a **60/70/80/90/100%** chance to generate a small amount of Elemental Particles, which will regenerate 6 Energy for the character. Can only occur once every **12/10.5/9/7.5/6**s.

passive.name: An End Sublime
passive.text: When using an Elemental Skill, ATK will be increased by **12/15/18/21/24%** for 15s, and a Bond of Life worth 25% of Max HP will be granted. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. When the Bond of Life is cleared, a maximum of **150/187.5/225/262.5/300** ATK will be gained based on **2.4/3/3.6/4.2/4.8%** of the total amount of the Life Bond cleared, lasting for 15s.

passive.name: Ironbone
passive.text: Increases Elemental Skill CRIT Rate by **8/10/12/14/16%**. Additionally, increases Energy Recharge by **16/20/24/28/32%** for 5s after using an Elemental Skill.

teams.name: Hydro Traveler in Nilou Bloom Team
Hydro Traveler in Nilou Bloom Team

substatLine: CRIT Rate > CRIT DMG > Elemental Mastery > Energy Recharge > ATK% or HP%
skillPriority: Elemental Skill > Elemental Burst > Normal Attack

entries.name: Foreign Stream
entries.text:
**Normal Attack**
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

**Charged Attack**
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

**Plunging Attack**
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

entries.name: Aquacrest Saber
entries.text:
Unleashes a torrent that can cleanse the world.

**Press**
Sends a Torrent Surge forward that will deal **Hydro DMG** to opponents it comes into contact with.

**Hold**
Enter Aiming Mode and constantly fire off Dewdrops in the direction in which you are aiming, dealing **Hydro DMG** to opponents they hit.
When the skill ends, it will send a Torrent Surge forward that will deal **Hydro DMG** to opponents it comes into contact with.
Suffusion: When using the Hold configuration of this skill, if the Traveler's HP is higher than 50%, the DMG dealt by Dewdrops will increase based on the Traveler's Max HP, and the Traveler will lose a fixed amount of HP every second.

**Arkhe: Pneuma**
At certain intervals, after using Torrent Surge, this skill will unleash a Spiritbreath Thorn that pierces opponents, dealing Pneuma-aligned **Hydro DMG**.

You studied the ripples in the water with Paimon.

entries.name: Rising Waters
entries.text:
Unleashes a slow-moving floating bubble that deals continuous **Hydro DMG** to nearby opponents.

You studied the ebb and flow of the tides with Paimon.

entries.name: Spotless Waters
entries.text:
After the Dewdrop fired by the Hold Mode of the **Aquacrest Saber** hits an opponent, a Sourcewater Droplet will be generated near to the Traveler. If the Traveler picks it up, they will restore 7% HP.
1 Droplet can be created this way every second, and each use of Aquacrest Saber can create 4 Droplets at most.

entries.name: Clear Waters
entries.text:
If HP has been consumed via Suffusion while using the Hold Mode **Aquacrest Saber**, the Torrent Surge at the skill's end will deal Bonus DMG equal to 45% of the total HP the Traveler has consumed in this skill use via Suffusion.
The maximum DMG Bonus that can be gained this way is 5,000.

entries.name: Foreign Aqualis
entries.text:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional **buffs**.

Additionally, when nearby party members' current HP increases or decreases by 5%, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Many Waters. You can gain 1 stack of Blade of Many Waters this way once every 4s, max 3 stacks. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Many Waters, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Many Waters and transform into the special **Charged Attack: Tidebound**.

**Charged Attack: Tidebound**
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased **Hydro DMG**. Increase in DMG is equal to 150% of Traveler's ATK,
· When Traveler's HP is no less than 50%, 10% of Traveler's Max HP will be consumed to increase DMG inflicted by each Charged Attack hit by 100% of Traveler's ATK.
· When Traveler's HP is lower than 50%, one instance of healing equal to 25% of Traveler's Max HP will be restored upon hitting an enemy.
· **Charged Attack: Tidebound** can be triggered up to once every 15s.

entries.name: Swelling Lake
entries.text:
Picking up a Sourcewater Droplet will restore 2 Energy to the Traveler.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Spotless Waters."

entries.name: Trickling Purity
entries.text: The Movement SPD of **Rising Waters**' bubble will be decreased by 30%, and its duration increased by 3s.

entries.name: Turbulent Ripples
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Aquacrest Saber** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Pouring Descent
entries.text:
When using **Aquacrest Saber**, an Aquacrest Aegis that can absorb 10% of the Traveler's Max HP in DMG will be created and will absorb **Hydro DMG** with 250% effectiveness. It will persist until the Traveler finishes using the skill.
Once every 2s, after a Dewdrop hits an opponent, if the Traveler is being protected by Aquacrest Aegis, the DMG Absorption of the Aegis will be restored to 10% of the Traveler's Max HP. If the Traveler is not presently being protected by an Aegis, one will be redeployed.

entries.name: Churning Whirlpool
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Rising Waters** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Tides of Justice
entries.text: When the Traveler picks up a Sourcewater Droplet, they will restore HP to a nearby party member with the lowest remaining HP percentage based on 6% of said member's Max HP.
